items.q: How much does sod installation cost in Montreal?
items.a: Most residential sod installations in Montreal range between $2 and $4 per square foot installed, depending on site prep, access and material grade. Every Grassmasters MTL quote is free and itemized.

items.q: How long does new sod take to root?
items.a: Sod typically knits to the soil within 10 to 14 days and is fully rooted in 4 to 6 weeks. Daily watering in the first two weeks is essential.

items.q: Do you remove the old grass before installing new sod?
items.a: Yes. We fully remove existing turf, level and amend the soil, then install fresh sod for tight, seamless results.

items.q: When is the best time to install sod in Montreal?
items.a: The ideal windows are mid-May through June and mid-August through early October, when cool temperatures and moisture help sod establish quickly.

items.q: How long does a typical installation take?
items.a: Most front or back yards are completed in a single day. Larger properties or combined hardscape projects take 2 to 4 days.
Absolutely. On-site estimates across Greater Montreal are free and no-obligation.
Montreal, Laval, West Island, South Shore, North Shore and most surrounding communities within about an hour of downtown.

items.q: Do you handle hardscaping and sod in one project?
items.a: Yes — many of our projects combine sod, mulch, stone and hardscape features under one crew and one project manager.

items.q: Do you offer a workmanship warranty?
items.a: Yes. We stand behind every installation. Warranty details are provided with each quote.

items.q: How do I water new sod?
items.a: Water thoroughly twice daily for the first 10 days, then reduce to once daily for a week, then taper to normal watering as roots establish.

services.heading: Premium landscaping services, tailored to your yard.
services.paragraph: One team, seven specialties. Every service delivered with the same obsessive attention to prep, materials and finish.

sod-installation.title: Sod Installation
sod-installation.desc: Premium fresh-cut sod delivered and installed the same day. We prep the soil, level the base and lay each strip tight-seamed for a seamless, magazine-cover finish.
sod-installation.longDesc: Every sod installation starts with a proper site visit — we check drainage, soil quality and sun exposure before quoting, so there are no surprises on install day. Old turf or bare soil is graded and levelled, a starter fertilizer is worked in, and fresh-cut sod is laid within hours of harvest for maximum root take. The result is a lawn that looks finished the moment we leave, and gets stronger every week after.

faq.q: How much watering does new sod need?
faq.a: Water twice daily for the first 10 days, then taper as roots establish over 4–6 weeks.

faq.q: Can I walk on it right away?
faq.a: Light foot traffic is fine after 10–14 days. Wait 4 weeks for regular use.

sod-removal.title: Sod Removal
sod-removal.desc: Complete removal of tired, dead or patchy turf — including hauling and disposal. We leave the soil ready for whatever comes next: sod, garden or hardscape.
sod-removal.longDesc: Whether your lawn is patchy, weed-choked or simply due for a full reset, we skim the entire turf layer — grass, thatch and root mat — down to clean soil. Everything is hauled away the same day, so there's no debris pile left behind. It's the essential first step before new sod, a garden bed or a hardscape project, and it's often the difference between a lawn that fails again in a year and one that thrives.

faq.a: Yes — we skim the full turf layer including thatch and root mat so replanting starts fresh.

hardscaping.title: Hardscaping
hardscaping.desc: Patios, walkways, retaining walls and stone features engineered for Montreal freeze-thaw cycles. Proper base, polymeric jointing and clean finishes.
hardscaping.longDesc: Montreal winters are hard on hardscaping that's built on shortcuts — that's why every patio, walkway or retaining wall we install starts with a properly excavated, frost-rated compacted base. Pavers are set true and level, joints are filled with polymeric sand to lock everything in place, and edges are restrained so nothing shifts after the first freeze-thaw cycle. Backed by manufacturer warranties, it's built to look as good in ten years as it does the day we finish.

faq.q: How long does a paver patio take?
faq.a: Most residential patios are completed in 2 to 5 days depending on size and design.

mulch-installation.title: Mulch Installation
mulch-installation.desc: Rich, colour-fast mulch installed with crisp bed edges. Locks in moisture, suppresses weeds and instantly frames your landscape.
mulch-installation.longDesc: A fresh mulch bed does more than look sharp — it locks in soil moisture through the summer, chokes out weeds before they start, and protects roots over winter. We cut crisp, defined bed edges first, then install an even, properly-depth layer of colour-fast mulch so it holds its look through the season instead of fading and washing out after the first few rains.

faq.q: How often should mulch be refreshed?
faq.a: A top-up every 1–2 years keeps beds looking fresh and performing well.

decorative-stone.title: Decorative Stone
decorative-stone.desc: Designer aggregates in a range of colours and sizes. Perfect for modern beds, borders and pathways that never need mowing.
decorative-stone.longDesc: Decorative stone is the lowest-maintenance way to frame a modern landscape — no mowing, no seasonal mulch top-ups, and no fading in the sun. We install commercial-grade landscape fabric underneath to keep weeds out and the stone clean, then hand-place a designer aggregate in the colour and size that fits your home, from fine pea gravel to bold statement rock.

faq.q: Do I need landscape fabric underneath?
faq.a: Yes — we install commercial-grade fabric to keep weeds out and stone clean.

river-stone.title: River Stone
river-stone.desc: Smooth, tumbled river rock for dry beds, downspout borders and modern landscape accents. Functional and beautiful.
river-stone.longDesc: Smooth, tumbled river stone earns its keep as much as it looks good — it's ideal for downspout runoff areas, drainage swales and dry creek beds where grass or mulch would wash out. We grade the area for proper flow, install fabric underneath, and set the stone at a depth that handles heavy rain without shifting, all while giving the bed a clean, modern finish.

faq.q: Can river stone handle heavy rain?
faq.a: Yes — it's ideal for drainage swales and downspout runoff areas.

lawn-transformations.title: Lawn Renovation & Transformations
lawn-transformations.desc: Whole-yard renovations combining sod, hardscape, mulch and stone into one cohesive, high-end landscape. One crew, one project manager, one flawless result.
lawn-transformations.longDesc: When a yard needs more than one thing fixed, a full transformation is almost always faster and better-looking than tackling each piece separately. We plan sod, hardscape, mulch and stone as one cohesive design from the start, so grades, materials and sightlines all line up. One crew and one project manager run the whole job, which means fewer handoffs, fewer surprises, and a finished yard that reads as a single, intentional design rather than a patchwork of add-ons.

faq.a: Yes — we help plan layout, materials and phasing during your free on-site estimate.
